description: Test automation engineering for a real-money sports betting exchange built as microservices.
Owns end-to-end acceptance coverage in a Python/pytest framework with about 26,000 integration tests.
Reduced inconsistent failures to a consistently green suite and built Jenkins tooling for personal test environments.
Backend development and API engineering with Python and FastAPI.
Worked on systems requiring clear behaviour, integration and reliability.
Test automation engineering for software products.
Built automation solutions with Python and integrated quality practices into the delivery cycle.
Backend software development with Java and Spring Boot.
Built and evolved services with a focus on integration, maintainability and verifiable behaviour.
Planned, estimated and developed automated test cases.
Built Python 2 and 3 frameworks with Nose and pytest, Docker images and CI execution.
Developed and executed performance tests with JMeter.
Test planning, Gherkin scenarios and API and microservice testing.
Python scripts to collect data from CSV files and Web APIs.
Python and pytest automation, alongside IVR system testing.
Analysed requirements and defined test strategies.
Executed functional, integration, system, regression and automated tests.
Deployed and validated solutions across Linux distributions and private clouds.
Executed and maintained test cases across diverse environments.
Reported and tracked defects with JIRA and Mantis.
Worked across web, desktop, Linux, Windows and UEFI projects.
Performed functional, integration and exploratory testing on web and desktop modules.
Reproduced customer-reported defects and verified fixes.
Tested new features and customer-specific customisations.
